account: Dorset Council planned to install Ally Labs acoustic and movement monitoring in six care homes to detect changes and support nighttime care. The Local Government Association case study describes 184 planned sensors, with installation starting in January 2025 and outcome reviews at three and six months. The case study reports no outcome. On 21 January 2026 Dorset Council reported that, comparing records before and after installation in six homes, total falls fell by 49.2% and hospital transfers by 79.3%. The maker adds that one home recorded more falls. On 28 April 2026 BBC News interviewed a resident whose fall the sensors detected. The BBC reported that one home will pay to keep the system after the funded trial.

ai_role.statement: The sensors learn each resident's usual night pattern and alert staff to sounds, movement and changes in that pattern. The council compared counts in the same homes before and after installation, with no comparison group. Two thirds of the homes also cut scheduled night checks. The council and the maker both say that local leadership and practice shaped the results, so the share due to the AI alerts is unknown.

The council reports that ambulance callouts fell by 63.7% and that two thirds of homes cut scheduled night checks. The acting manager of one participating home told the BBC that the home will pay to keep the system after the trial ended.

must_hold: The conditions needed to reproduce the benefit are unspecified.
produced_by: The source describes planned installation of 184 sensors across six care homes, with follow-up reviews at three and six months.
The system combines microphones and infrared sensing with an application for care staff.

revisions.change: Linked a comparable incident in the AI Incident Database (incident 1109).

Added three sources, one of them independent; corrected the details of one cited source; dated the case to January 2025 (observed); changed the benefit status from intended to reported; rated the depth 3 for a person, 2 for an organization; recorded what the benefit is measured against; recorded what happened later (persisted); revised the account of the AI's contribution.
Edited the headline, summary, metric, account of events for accuracy and clarity.

summary: Dorset Council reports that total falls fell by 49.2% and hospital transfers by 79.3% after six care homes installed Ally Labs acoustic and movement sensors.
system: Ally Labs acoustic-monitoring sensors and associated application
title: Dorset Council: acoustic monitoring in care homes
